Required implementation / copy-ready con: Implement a bounded SCORM 1.2 window/opener search for window.API; handle cross-origin access errors safely; call LMSInitialize("") once before runtime use; if API absent show untracked preview status without fake completion. Use LMSGetLastError/LMSGetErrorString for diagnostics without customer data.
Acceptance test: Launch in LMS iframe/popup, preview without API and blocked parent-access cases; no infinite search or false tracked pass.

Required implementation / copy-ready con: Read cmi.core.lesson_status, lesson_location, entry, score and suspend_data after initialization. Only set incomplete on a new attempt when appropriate; never overwrite an existing passed state on resume. Set cmi.core.exit="suspend" for incomplete exits and write location/state before commit.
Acceptance test: Resume preserves status and position; new and resumed attempts are distinguishable.

Required implementation / copy-ready con: Use cmi.core.score.raw/min/max on a 0–100 scale. Module pass requires all required screens visited AND raw score >=80; set lesson_status=passed only then. Failed submitted attempt sets failed; mid-course stays incomplete. Final exam uses the same exact-score threshold. Capstone SCO status describes readiness only, not human rubric approval.
Acceptance test: 4/5 passes; 3/5 fails; 36/44 passes; 35/44 fails; 79.999 does not become pass by display rounding.

Required implementation / copy-ready con: Store compact versioned JSON with current screen index, visited-screen bitset, stable question/option IDs for current attempt, response keys and submitted result. Keep encoded UTF-8 payload within SCORM 1.2 suspend_data limit of 4096 characters; reserve margin and test worst case. No customer data, large narrative drafts or audio/video in suspend_data.
Acceptance test: Maximum module and final exam state fits <=4096 characters; overflow has a defined safe fallback without corrupting pass evidence.

Required implementation / copy-ready con: Commit at screen checkpoints and after quiz submission. Write cmi.core.lesson_location and session_time (SCORM 1.2 CMITimespan format). Set exit appropriately and LMSCommit(""); call LMSFinish("") once on controlled exit. Use pagehide/beforeunload best effort only, not as the sole persistence path.
Acceptance test: Abrupt close/relaunch loses at most last checkpoint; no duplicate finish, negative time or reset of prior passed state.

Required implementation / copy-ready con: When supported, record cmi.interactions.n.id, type=choice, student_response, result, weighting and latency using SCORM 1.2 allowed vocabularies/ID syntax. Do not fail the course solely because optional interaction tracking is unsupported; preserve overall score/status and log sanitized diagnostic.
Acceptance test: Verify results and answer mapping in LMS reports; unsupported optional fields degrade gracefully.
Basis / source IDs: Authored contract; verify target LMS support

Required implementation / copy-ready con: Each module has 8 authored questions; draw 5 without replacement. Overall final draws Settings per-module counts for SBP-101–113 (44 total from a 104-item eligible pool). SBP-200 8 items are formative only. Seed/resume the selected attempt; shuffle options preserving answer IDs, not letter labels. Equal points; blank is incorrect.
Acceptance test: Draw counts match Settings; no duplicates in attempt; option shuffling never changes correct identity; capstone items excluded from final.

Required implementation / copy-ready con: Module practice may show debriefs; graded module feedback after submission. Final feedback after submission under approved policy. Proposed 2 graded attempts before administrator reset; preserve review and remediation route. Client-side SCORM cannot provide high-stakes anti-tamper security; stronger enforcement/proctoring requires LMS/server capabilities.
Acceptance test: Failed attempt review and reset behave as approved; no claim of secure/proctored exam from browser code.

Required implementation / copy-ready con: Target WCAG 2.2 AA as proposed build standard: semantic HTML, keyboard navigation, visible focus, labeled inputs, non-color status, sufficient contrast, text equivalents, captions/transcripts and reduced-motion support. No drag-only assessment or timed essential content without accommodation.
Acceptance test: Manual keyboard/screen-reader checks plus automated accessibility checks; print/text equivalent for matrix and workflow interactions.

Required implementation / copy-ready con: Use local fonts/assets or safe fallbacks; bundle learner dependencies locally. No runtime API/model call required. Avoid embedded internal source documents and external tracking. Validate at 1280px desktop and 390px mobile widths; no horizontal scrolling or clipped controls.
Acceptance test: Disconnected post-launch content and assets work subject to LMS session constraints; scripts have no remote data dependency.
